findings.title: Recheck the absolute deadline after the KILL-eligibility poll
findings.trigger: The eligibility poll or scheduling returns late with None; no immediate clock predicate follows that return.
findings.impact: A new direct-caller KILL can be attempted after end-1.5s or the original phase end. The later remaining check bounds wait only after KILL.
findings.alarm_limit: until samples the relative duration before handler/timer setup and arms that unchanged duration later; the alarm is not an independent post-poll absolute gate.
findings.minimal_repair: Retain the actual poll value, sample the shared clock immediately after it even for None, and permit KILL only strictly before the unchanged reap and phase ends. Preserve real exit/null, bounded wait, retained direct handle, no later file writes if unreaped, and all no-retry/no-other-target limits.
findings.evidence_kind: Static source ordering deduction only; no runtime race or signal was exercised.
